description: Preview or atomically commit the current Inventory Mission Control revision into created purchase-order, transfer-order and manufacturing-order drafts with durable mission lineage. A manufacture line drafts a manufacturing order at its warehouse from the item's primary bill of materials, planned from the commit day plus the line's lead time; a manufacture line whose item has no bill of materials it can build from blocks the commit by SKU (defer the line or add the BOM). First call without previewReceipt/idempotencyKey; after reviewing the exact draft groups, repeat with both plus the returned artifact fingerprint. Both phases rebuild canonical evidence and fail with PLAN_SOURCE_CHANGED on any drift. Commit requires Write scope plus replenishment.prepare. It never issues a purchase order or manufacturing order, submits or reserves a transfer, receives inventory, or starts production. Client-pinned purchase drafts are supported; client-pinned transfers and manufacturing fail closed until those orders carry client ownership. The committed result lists every created draft with its id and type.

expectedArtifactFingerprint.description: Artifact fingerprint returned by preview; required for commit.

expectedSourceFingerprint.description: Exact sourceFingerprint returned by that revision.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt.

previewReceipt.description: Receipt returned by the preview call; omit on preview.
